name: Eoin Buckley
biography: Michael Eoin Buckley is a senior cybersecurity consultant at BlackBerry with over 20 years’ experience spanning cybersecurity consultancy, product security and both security and physical layer aspects of 3GPP cellular, Zigbee and IETF standards. In his role he leads the cybersecurity engineering effort and specializes in product security assessments of several areas such as automotive, healthcare and aerospace. Eoin holds a Ph.D. from Cornell University with a thesis focus on error control coding.
